title: A signed-in person stays signed in across a reload
description:
## Found on `chatticus-c54569`

A person who already signed in with Google is sent through Google's account picker again after a reload, a new tab, or returning to `/chat`. It looks like the product will not keep them signed in.

This is not Cursor-vs-Chrome cookies (that is a separate jar). It is the SPA itself.

## Why it happens

`chatticus-349634` put OIDC tokens in in-memory storage only, and every Google authorization request includes `prompt=select_account`. That combination is correct **after an explicit sign-out** (the next person on a shared machine must see the chooser). It is wrong for an ordinary reload: the tab forgets the session, so the next visit is treated as a fresh sign-in and Google asks again.

## What this does not change

- Signing out still ends the Cognito and Google SSO session (`signoutRedirect` with `id_token_hint`).
- Signing back in **after sign-out** still includes `prompt=select_account`.
- Do not enable `ADMIN_NO_SRP_AUTH`. Do not add a second auth path.

## Gherkin (behavior to add; keep existing sign-out scenarios)

```
Feature: Signed-in Google session survives a reload
  As a person who already signed in with Google
  I want the workspace to still know who I am after I refresh or return to /chat
  So that I am not sent through Google's account picker on every visit

  Scenario: Reloading the workspace keeps the signed-in session
    Given the web SPA has an active signed-in session
    When the person reloads the workspace
    Then the web SPA still has that signed-in session
    And the person is not sent through Google sign-in

  Scenario: Signing back in after sign-out still prompts for account selection
    Given the person has signed out of the web SPA
    When the person starts Google sign-in from the web SPA
    Then the Google authorization request includes prompt "select_account"
```

## Done when

A signed-in person can reload `/chat` (and open it again in the same browser) and remain signed in, without Google's account picker. After they click Sign out, the next sign-in still shows the chooser. Behavior in Gherkin first. `chatticus-349634` remains true.

Composer 2.5 planning. Worktree to be named `/tmp/chatticus-0b0208-session-persist` on `feat/0b0208-session-survives-reload`. Implementation not authorized until the plan is reviewed.

Keep `chatticus-349634`: Cognito sign-out redirect and `prompt=select_account` after explicit sign-out. Persist the OIDC user across reload (oidc-client-ts default store is fine; in-memory-only is the defect). Gherkin first. No `ADMIN_NO_SRP_AUTH`. No second auth path.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with holes closed. Human confirmed: they were signed in and a reload sent them through Google again. Treat that as the defect, not a missing sign-in.

Worktree to create first, then implement: `/tmp/chatticus-0b0208-session-persist` on `feat/0b0208-session-survives-reload` from `origin/develop`. Do not touch the primary clone.

**Closed on authorize:**
1. Harness: file-backed `Storage` only. No `node-localstorage`.
2. Production `userStore`: explicit `new WebStorageStateStore({ store: window.localStorage })`. One path. Auth is client-only (`use client` + `useEffect`). Do not keep in-memory as a dual reader.
3. Tighten the existing after-sign-out scenario with `Given` signed out. Do not duplicate it.
4. Step phrase: `the web SPA persisted session is cleared`.
5. Manager runs live reload acceptance after merge to `develop` and web deploy. Keep `prompt=select_account` after explicit sign-out (`349634`).
6. Gherkin first, then the `userStore` change. No `ADMIN_NO_SRP_AUTH`. No cookies, no second auth path.

Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.
